notes: No starting section was posted. The Objective No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave? is the starting card; Start Your Engines! (posted in the Interrupts) is taken as the starting interrupt for this podracing deck. All cards count toward the 60 (posted section counts total 60).

The post says this is the deck Winkelhaus played to win the 2001 European Championship ('Continentals'), beating Martin Falke twice (by 31 and 33) and Peter Di Biasio in the final (by 38). The wiki has no 2001 European Championship event page, so the deck is kept as a general DeckTech list.
